description: Use this when the person wants to find published new-build projects (empreendimentos) in Portugal on flatin.pt. Do not use it for one project's details (`get_newbuild` with its slug) or for how much is being built (`construction_barometer`). With `typology`, the budget applies to those typologies' prices; projects without a published price drop out when a budget is given. Pass next_offset as `offset` for the next page. A misspelt filter is refused, not ignored. Prices are as checked on developers' pages or agency listings, dated.

delivery_by.description: Completed, or promised for this year or earlier (overdue promises included), e.g. 2027; at most five years back. Projects with no announced date are left out

energy_class.description: Energy certificate class of at least one unit, as stated by the source. Often not published: filter only when asked

language.description: Language of the page URLs and of the labels (stage, typology, nearby places); the text summary shows the typology labels in it. Field names stay English. uk is accepted as ua.

municipality.description: City / municipality (concelho): name, slug or four-digit code, e.g. Porto, Lisboa, Vila Nova de Gaia, Matosinhos, 1312. English names (Lisbon) and accents-free spelling are understood; an ambiguous name (Lagoa) is refused with candidates

offset.description: Skip this many results: pass next_offset from the previous answer

on_sale.description: Only projects with a published price

parish.description: Parish (freguesia) name. Exact name, accents optional

price_max.description: Budget upper bound in euros, e.g. 350000. With typology, the budget applies to those typologies' prices. Projects with no published price are left out when a budget is given

sort.description: price: cheapest first; delivery: soonest first; new: recently added first. Projects with a price always come before those without

stage.description: Construction stage: planned, licensed, building (under construction), selling (on sale), delivered (completed)

typology.description: Bedrooms: T0 studio … T5 (five or more). Any of the listed matches

name: search_newbuilds

next_offset.description: Pass as offset for the next page; null = last

outputSchema.description: Success, or a refusal with an error code. Units: *_cents euro cents, *_eur euros, *_eur_m2 euros per m², *_pct and percent in percent.

title: Search new-build projects in Portugal
